dbToolScopingDenylist.unsaid_rooms: Rooms are guest-owned (member token, no account), so the table has no owner_email. One JSON doc per room holds sealed picks, votes and token hashes. Every real read goes through viewRoom() in server/domain/view.ts. The raw database tools see an unscoped table as an empty view (1 = 0 in the framework's scoping.js) and the chat agent has no raw database tool.
